title: fix(console): data-page filter chips name lookup records and say booleans in the reader’s language; condition sentences use translated labels
body:
Fixes #37288
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在对象数据页上,从仪表盘下钻过来的筛选标签不再显示关联记录的编号和 true/false,而是显示记录名称和当前语言的「是/否」;共享规则等处的条件句子改用翻译后的字段名和选项名。
- 为什么做:补齐上一张「下拉选项筛选标签显示翻译名」修复留下的同类缺口,让中文用户看到的整行标签不再半中半英。
- 出错会怎样:只影响标签上的显示文字,不改变筛选结果;读不到记录名时退回显示原编号,可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The `/data` page's URL filter chips and the read-only `filter-condition` sentence now draw each comparand the way the grid cell draws it:

- **(a) Lookup** (`ObjectDataPage`): a whole-value comparand on a lookup field reads as the referenced record's name. The page reuses the read the list's own condition chips already make, `useLookupValueNames` (the target's records by id through the page's data source, named by the lookup's `displayField`, else the target's name field via `referencedRecordTitle`), now exported from `@object-ui/plugin-list` with its two types. No new fetch path: the same `find` + `getObjectSchema` read, one per target, keyed on target and ids. While the read is in flight, when it fails, or when it names nothing, the chip keeps the raw id. The record-trail source condition is left out of the read, because its chip is named by the trail.
- **(b) Boolean** (`ObjectDataPage`): a `[bool]` comparand reads as `t('filterBuilder.trueLabel' | 'filterBuilder.falseLabel')`, the keys `FilterConditionField` already uses, which are present in all locale packs. The text `true` on a text field is still the user's own comparand and stays raw.
- **(c) `describeCondition`** (`FilterConditionField`): the read-only sentence receives the field list mapped through `useSafeFieldLabel()`'s `fieldLabel` and `translateOptions` for the object, so field and option labels are the translated ones, with the authored label as the fallback.
- **(d) `[nin]`**: no code change. The arm was already correct; it is now pinned.
- **New export (the widening):** `@object-ui/plugin-list` adds `useLookupValueNames` and its two types, `LookupValueName` and `NamedCondition`, to its package entry (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx`, +6). Nothing is removed or renamed. The changeset declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)` at `patch` for all three packages. This follows AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3: "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`"; `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`) and the precedents on `main`: `.changeset/35053-lookup-label-namefield.md` (`referencedRecordTitle`, a new `@object-ui/core` export, `patch`), `.changeset/35033-form-recomputes-formulas.md` (`planObjectFormulas`, `@object-ui/core`, `patch`) and `.changeset/33581-plugin-detail-core-subpath.md` (a new `@object-ui/plugin-detail/core` subpath, `patch`).
- `drillUrlFilters.ts`: doc comments only. `ComparandText` / `FilterChip` now describe the caller's drawing in general terms (option label, record name, boolean word) rather than options only.

Landing points are the ones the claim names, plus one line in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx`: the export of the existing read. Reusing it is how (a) avoids a new fetch path, so the split rule did not fire.

## Tests

One top-level `describe` per item in the existing harnesses, in en and zh:

- `ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx`: (a) lookup: `=` in zh, `[in]` in en and zh, CONTROL for an unnamed id after the read settles, CONTROL for a failed read keeping the raw id. (b) boolean: `[bool]=true|false` in zh, `true` in en with the packs differing, CONTROL for the word `true` on a text field staying raw. (d) `[nin]`: zh and en option labels, CONTROL for a member with no matching option staying raw.
- `FilterConditionField.readWords-30209.test.tsx`: (c) the zh field and option labels, the authored en labels under en, CONTROL for an untranslated field or option keeping its authored label, CONTROL for a value with no matching option staying as stored.

### Ablations (one-off, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: mutate, run, restore, with the restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

| Leg | Mutation | Red (observed) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A1 (a) | drop the `lookupNameOf` lookup in the page's `comparandText` | 3 lookup pins plus the mixed unnamed-id control, which also asserts a named member. The failed-read control stays green. |
| A2 (b) | drop the boolean line | the 3 boolean pins. The text-field control stays green. |
| A3 (d) | remove `not_in` from `WHOLE_VALUE_OP_WORDS` | the 2 `[nin]` pins. The raw-member control stays green. |
| A4 (c) | pass the untranslated `fields` to `describeFilterGroup` | the zh pin and both zh controls (each asserts the translated field label). The en pin stays green. |
| A5 (c) | drop only the `translateOptions` mapping | the zh pin alone. The option half is pinned separately from the field half. |

Every subject is imported from source (`./ObjectDataPage`, `../../index`), so no leg depends on a `dist/` rebuild.

## Acceptance notes

- The record name comes from `referencedRecordTitle` (core's ADR-0079 ladder), which the list's condition chips use. The grid cell's `useLookupName` resolves through `getRecordDisplayName` on the same ladder and also masks fields the reader may not read before naming. For a backend that strips denied fields, the two produce the same name. The chip takes the list-chip read so that the two chip rows on one page agree.
- A `user`-type field without a declared `reference` still shows the raw id, the same as the list's own chip (`useLookupValueNames` reads only `reference`). Noted, not filed.
- The editable `FilterBuilder` inside `FilterConditionField` still receives authored field and option labels (it has no translation step of its own). This is outside (c), which names the read-only sentence, and it is unmeasured in a browser, so it is noted here and not fixed.
